ModMetaData.name: Wraith & Nanite Gravtech
ModMetaData.author: Vardath
ModMetaData.description: Unofficial, non-commercial fan-made RimWorld 1.6 mod inspired by Stargate Atlantis and SG-1. The rebuilt foundation begins with autonomous block Replicators and expands through Wraith, Asuran and gravtech systems. CatCraft's Stargates!, ONAC and RimGate integrations are optional.
